title: 重新思考结构化生成：基于图的推理能否解决歧义？
summary: 该论文将结构化生成重新表述为歧义感知推理问题，不再预测单一输出，而是对多个语义有效但结构不同的候选进行推理。方法构建候选结构化输出空间，将每个候选表示为实体关系图，通过语义对齐与关系一致性进行图推理选择，实验显示在准确率、稳定性和鲁棒性上均有提升。
summary_en: This paper reformulates structured generation as an ambiguity-aware inference problem, reasoning over multiple semantically valid but structurally distinct outputs instead of predicting a single one. It builds a candidate space, represents each candidate as an entity-relationship graph, and selects via graph-based reasoning over semantic alignment and relational consistency, showing gains in accuracy, stability, and robustness.
